verdict.rationale: Supabase explicitly documents branching as isolated preview environments for schema/config changes before production (supabase-docs-10/17/24/50), and the MCP server exposes agent-callable branching tools (`create_branch`, `merge_branch`, `reset_branch`, `rebase_branch`) explicitly framed as letting agents 'test changes in a safe environment before merging them to production' (supabase-supp-mcp-tool-groups, supabase-supp-mcp-agent-security). This directly matches an AI agent creating/testing schema changes in a branch before production. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent actually exercising branching tools end-to-end, and the branching MCP tools are labeled experimental in docs.
